_what: Re-read of Google Search Console for uscisexam.com after the 2026-08-27 reachability fix (local-guides-generator #38, ddd60cf), as gsc_uscisexam_2026-08-27.json asked: 'It should be re-read after that fix has had time to be recrawled.'
source: Search Console API (searchAnalytics.query + urlInspection.index:inspect), service account gsc-automation-493801, property sc-domain:uscisexam.com, read-only scope
technical_checks: All six cluster URLs return 200, robots meta index,follow, self-referencing canonical, listed in sitemap-guides.xml with an honest content-hashed lastmod (2026-08-27); robots.txt allows Googlebot; the /guides/ hub that links all of them is indexed (crawled 2026-09-26).
findings: The recrawl has not happened. All six reachability-fix guides are 'Discovered - currently not indexed' with NO crawl on record, six weeks after the fix. Google knows the URLs and has chosen not to fetch them; it has 0 impressions to judge them on. The fix is untested by Google, not failed.

No fixable technical cause was found: 200, index,follow, self canonical, in the sitemap with honest lastmod, robots allows, linked from an indexed hub. 'Discovered - not indexed' with no crawl on a low-authority domain is Google's crawl-demand choice, which a code change here cannot force.

Site-wide, 10 of 91 inspected URLs are indexed. Of the 16 guides, 3 are indexed (the hub, after-your-exam-next-steps, costs-and-timeframes, all crawled 2026-09-26..10-01), 11 discovered-not-indexed, 2 unknown (document-checklist, questions-to-ask-a-civil-surgeon). The doctor-funnel guides (i-693-medical-exam-requirements, uscis-medical-exam-cost, uscis-medical-exam-overview) are in the same not-crawled state.

The 57 /<city>/next-steps/ pages are where Google spends crawl and declines: 23 crawled-not-indexed, 4 'Google chose different canonical', 18 discovered-not-indexed, 11 unknown, 1 indexed. Crawled-then-dropped plus duplicate-canonical is Google's near-duplicate signal for that template.

Performance since the fix (2026-08-28..10-05): 0 clicks, 31 impressions, average position 73.4 (before, 3 months: 0 clicks, 38 impressions, position 61.4). The naturalization query 'citizenship test preparation columbia sc' did not recur.
_not_measured: States beyond the first 8 of 50 and the 56 city pages (sitemap-cities.xml) were not URL-inspected.
Bing, the portfolio's citation surface, is a separate dataset and was not read here.
